title: centaurea raphanina subsp. mixta
intro: Centaurea raphanina subsp. mixta, commonly known as the Cornflower or Raphanina, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea raphanina subsp. mixta include its ability to calm inflammation and act as an antiseptic, making it a potential treatment for minor wounds and skin infections. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
